value.answer: With no fever and just a mild cough and runny nose for 2 days, this sounds like an ordinary cold - most kids stay their usual playful selves through it. Keep fluids up and use saline drops/gentle suction for the nose. Symptoms often peak around day 3-4, then ease over a week or so.
value.triage: Call Health811 (811) if a fever develops, things get worse after day 5, symptoms drag past 10 days, or your child seems unusually tired, off food, or has ear pain. Go to the ER or call 911 now if breathing looks fast or laboured, ribs pull in, lips look blue, or your child becomes floppy or hard to wake.
